technical.lead: FMRB EO Sunday hold: classified-annex doubly weekend-aged, Memorial Day on deck
technical.body: The Frontier Model Review Board executive order moved into its post-deadline Sunday weekend with the now-settled eight-of-eight Friday classified-annex close holding as a two-day-old artifact and OSTP holding its 'signing window open from end-of-day May 22 forward' line through the second weekend day without weekend signing activity, leaving Tuesday May 26 as the operative business-resumption target after the federal Memorial Day Monday observance and pushing the canonical post-deadline arithmetic to a full three-day weekend hold. A Sunday Lawfare weekend reading characterized the now-cleared Senate Cyber Subcommittee classified-annex response curve — NSA Director, FBI Cyber Division Assistant Director, and OMB Federal CIO substantive responses all logged Friday and unchanged through the weekend — as the canonical settled-state input the post-Memorial-Day OSTP signing-window calendar will run against, with no fresh Sunday weekend revisions to the eight-witness response record. A Sunday Just Security weekend analysis observed that the doubly-weekend-aged classified-annex close now sits as the cleanest pre-Memorial-Day settled-state reading the FMRB process has produced and that the OECD GENAI plenary cohort plus the House parallel-track cohort can both continue to cite the eight-of-eight close as a stable shared regulatory anchor heading into the business-Tuesday reopen. The House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee on Communications and Technology continued to hold its Wednesday May 27 morning markup slot on the parallel 30-day technical-review joint-resolution draft cleanly through the Sunday weekend without modification.

The Sunday scan report placed the US cohort tightening to roughly 238 and the India cohort to approximately 126 over the closing weekend taper, with the CISA mandatory-attestation submission portal in its third operating day post-deadline and its second weekend operating window logging only a single-digit handful of submissions consistent with the deeper Sunday business-quiet cadence. Censys honeypot telemetry reported exploitation attempts easing to roughly 1.2x baseline through the Sunday 09:00 UTC mark — the third consecutive sub-1.5x reading and the deepest weekend taper of the cycle, consistent with commodity-tier exploit-kit volume continuing its scheduled three-day-weekend taper. CISA's Sunday weekend operations note confirmed the compliance-monitoring phase holding cleanly into its third operating day with the eleven-CVE Trail of Bits agent-loader taxonomy compliance window now sitting as a doubly-weekend-aged settled regulatory precedent.

technical.lead: Cerebras CBRS Sunday: doubly weekend-aged upper-band read into Memorial Day
technical.body: Cerebras CBRS extended its market-closure weekend hold-steady through the Sunday closing pre-Memorial-Day day with Friday's post-event reaction tape now sitting as the doubly-weekend-aged settled fourth-consecutive-session upper-half-of-analyst-band read, and the sell-side cycling cleanly into the closing weekend coverage hold ahead of the three-day Memorial Day market closure that pushes the next concrete trading session to Tuesday May 26. A Sunday BEAMSTART weekend note reported the five-desk analyst spread holding Friday's tightening for a second consecutive weekend day — Bernstein's $185 Market-Perform floor still held, Morgan Stanley's $192 target with the upside-scenario probability at Friday's 54 percent (its first reading above the half-probability threshold and now holding cleanly through both weekend days), Wells Fargo Securities Buy at $220, Jefferies Outperform at $225, and UBS Neutral at $215 — with institutional-buyside cumulative net position holding at Friday's roughly 44 percent of float through the closing pre-Memorial-Day weekend hold and the cohort flagging the now-doubly-weekend-aged FMRB classified-annex eight-of-eight close as the canonical settled second-order regulatory-anchor input the trading week closed on. The Sunday wire characterized Friday's close as the canonical doubly-weekend-aged settled-state read for the three-day Memorial Day weekend hold and Tuesday May 26 as the operative next concrete tape catalyst window.

technical.lead: Mistral Workflows day-24: twelve-reference cohort holds doubly weekend-aged

Mistral's Sunday weekend note reported the twelve-reference cohort — France DGFiP, Germany Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit, UK HMRC, Italy Agenzia delle Entrate, Spain AEAT, Portugal Autoridade Tributaria, Belgium FOD Financien, Netherlands Belastingdienst, Sweden Skatteverket, Denmark Skattestyrelsen, Norway Skatteetaten, and Switzerland Federal Tax Administration — unchanged with no fresh weekend selection across both weekend days, consistent with the deeper Sunday cadence the program has carried since launch; paid Workflows tenancy edged to approximately 436 enterprise customers and the daily-execution count to roughly 8.0M. The paper, positioned as a second workshop-style consolidation extension rather than a fresh formal model, applies the now-canonical four-paper reference (Wednesday's 2605.07891 consolidation survey plus Thursday's 2605.08019 applied-deployment evaluation companion plus Friday's 2605.08147 operator-side compliance-monitoring evaluation companion plus Saturday's 2605.08234 workshop-consolidation companion) to the federal-civilian directive's second full weekend operating window under compliance-monitoring mode, and reports the eleven-operator sample's per-operator attestation-event arithmetic holding inside the consolidation survey's predicted bounds for a fifth consecutive cross-section sample.
